checks.criterion: Complete worked example and numerical logic

checks.criterion: Source-only claims and SAMPLE/REAL truth boundary
checks.evidence: Official requirement wording is bound to source packet/PDF page 1. §8 disclaims real client, receipt, authority, attachment, signature, approval, delivery, and outcomes. Blank fields are confined to appendices explicitly labeled REAL replacement areas.

All 67 unique sequential IDs, values, types, locators, and replacement cells in §9 table 16 match the five-column R12 CSV exactly; no empty cells. Some per-fact replacement cells do not name an accountable source provider, verifier, or recalculator; see finding SEM-REGISTER-RESP-01.

F01-F20 and intake/confirmation/authorization/HOLD/handoff mechanics identify a customer course-needs application form. DOCX §1 and §7 distinguish 0015 evaluation/reply, 0016 EDM copy, and 0017 website copy; 0013 annual course disclosure and 0018 PDDRO map are expressly non-substitutes.

checks.criterion: Internal control metadata in user-facing content
checks.evidence: Printed body exposes document revision/status labels R17 and SAMPLE candidate, consistent with its unaccepted state, but no SHA, Blueprint row hash, QA receipt ID, worker ID, queue, or control-plane tokens. DOCX core properties carry a non-rendered comments note referring to an R14 repair and author fields; these are metadata, not page content.

findings.category: Synthetic register accountability / real replacement traceability
findings.locator: §9, embedded table 16, column 「升格 REAL 所需替換來源與責任」; rows SYN-0014-002, SYN-0014-003, SYN-0014-016, SYN-0014-040 (and comparable rows).

evidence_examples.cell_text: 原始收件系統時間、郵件標頭或實際紙本收件戳記
實際電子郵件、紙本、網站匯出或接洽紀錄及定位
以替換後的現況及目標按同一公式重算
以實際目標人數及分母重算；不得報為成果

findings.finding: These cells give a source or recalculation instruction but do not consistently identify who obtains/verifies the source or performs/checks the recalculation. §§2 and 10 provide broad roles, so the gap is partly inferable, but the per-fact register does not consistently bind responsibility as its column heading and Blueprint call for.
findings.impact: The sample remains truthful and usable, and fact/value/location linkage is complete; responsibility for a subset of real replacements is less directly auditable.
findings.recommended_action: For each affected row, name the responsible source provider and the role that verifies or recomputes the value, or add an exact row-level cross-reference to the applicable responsibility rule; keep the embedded table and R12 CSV aligned.

metadata_observations.detail: R17 and candidate status are printed as document version/status cues. The core-properties comments field contains an internal R14 scoped-repair note and author metadata, but these are not rendered in evaluator-facing page content.

supplemental_fact_check.claim: The fictional contact address uses the reserved .invalid namespace so it is not presented as a real contact route.
supplemental_fact_check.source_title: RFC 2606: Reserved Top Level DNS Names
supplemental_fact_check.finding: Supports using .invalid for a clearly invalid example address.
